name: Soyuz MS-16
about: Soyuz MS-16 (2020-023A), a crewed vehicle (Soyuz MS), launched 2020 Apr  9. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2020 Apr  9), held fixed
docked to S36086; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
